notes.title: 🛠️ Shadow Protocol Stability Update – We Hear You! 🛠️
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve seen your feedback about game crashes, especially during espionage missions and high-action sequences. First off, thank you so much for sharing your experiences and supporting Shadow Protocol![/p][p][/p][p]What’s Happening:[/p][p]Some players are running into crashes that disrupt gameplay, and we know how frustrating this can be.[/p][p][/p][p]What We’re Doing:[/p][p]We’re actively investigating these stability issues and working on a patch to improve performance across all hardware setups. Your feedback is incredibly helpful for us to diagnose and fix the problem quickly.[/p][p][/p][p]How You Can Help:[/p][p]If you encounter a crash, please reply here (or email[/p][p][url="https://shawnfuteran.dev@gmail.com)"]shawnfuteran.dev@gmail.com)[/url] with:[/p][list][*][p]What you were doing when the crash happened[/p][/*][*][p]Any error messages or crash logs (if available)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]What’s Next:[/p][p]We’ll keep you posted on progress and will announce when a stability update is live. Thank you for your patience and for helping us make Shadow Protocol even better![/p][p][/p][p]— Shawn Futeran[/p]
